faqs.question: What is the current market price per square foot for different localities in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: The market price per square foot in Mumbai varies greatly depending on the locality. For upscale areas like South Mumbai, Cuffe Parade, prices can range from ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 per square foot. In areas like Bandra, Andheri, and Powai, prices are typically between ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per square foot. More affordable localities like Mira Road and Bhayander offer properties in the range of ₹7,000 to ₹10,000 per square foot. Please consult an AuraLiving real estate advisor or check our latest property listings for live rates.

faqs.question: What are the essential documents required to buy a property in India?
faqs.answer: Essential documents for buying property include the Sale Deed, Mother Deed/Title Deed, Encumbrance Certificate (EC), latest property tax receipts, Khata Certificate, and Occupation Certificate (OC) for ready-to-move-in properties. Additionally, the Sale Agreement must be registered under RERA guidelines with stamp duty paid.

faqs.question: Which are the popular localities to buy a residential plot or new project in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Popular localities to buy residential projects include Navi Mumbai (Vashi, Panvel, and Kharghar), Thane (Ghodbunder Road, Majiwada, and Kalyan), and western suburbs like Malad, Goregaon, and Borivali. These areas offer strong infrastructure, metro connectivity, and strong capital appreciation.

faqs.question: Which is the best residential area for families in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: The ideal area depends on lifestyle and budget: South Mumbai (Tardeo, Parel, Worli) for elite sea-facing infrastructure; Bandra West for vibrant cosmopolitan culture and top international schools; Powai for tranquil lake views and modern gated townships; and Juhu for peaceful beachside living.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to buy a house in Mumbai and tier-1 cities?
faqs.answer: Costs vary across segments. Ultra-luxury properties in prime South Mumbai or Golf Course Road Gurugram can exceed ₹10 Crores. Premium mid-range apartments in Andheri, Powai, or Bangalore Whitefield typically range between ₹1 Crore to ₹3 Crores. Emerging suburbs offer 1 BHK and 2 BHK apartments starting from ₹45 Lakhs to ₹75 Lakhs.

faqs.answer: No! AuraLiving operates on a 100% Zero Brokerage model for all new developer projects and builder listings. Our advisory, property tours, paperwork assistance, and home loan facilitation are completely free for buyers.

faqs.answer: Every single project featured on AuraLiving is audited by our legal research desk to verify valid RERA registration numbers, approved building plans, title clarity, and escrow compliance before being published on our platform.
